analysis: The PR changes documentation only. docs/developer/test.md adds a 'Deadline Admission Estimators' section at head lines 373-401. It describes the scripted-engine unit suites EngineMeasurementOrderingTests, AdmissionRateEstimatorTests, CBv2PerBatchDecodeChargeTests and CBv2PerBatchDecodeConversionTests, and the swift test commands that run them. docs/provider/cli-reference.md adds one table row at line 1751 that lists DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES as an environment variable passed through, with a pointer to DeadlineAdmissionFixes.environmentKey. No runtime code, key handling, attestation, authorization or encryption path is modified. The documented tests use synthetic numeric usage with no model, GPU or live provider state. The text states they do not qualify live refusal rates, routing or performance, so it does not overclaim security properties (compare T-056 and T-058). The new env-var row only documents a knob; I cannot see the source for DeadlineAdmissionFixes. It concerns TTFT/deadline admission rate estimation, which is a scheduling and availability matter. A plausible link to T-041 is only through TTFT timing, and nothing in the supplied evidence shows cache scoping, the TTL or the cache gate (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE) changing. The remaining integration question is whether the underlying admission-estimator source change, outside this batch, weakens the T-010/T-029 availability posture or the SEC-035 TTFT-oracle posture. This docs-only change introduces no regression and does not require a threat-model update on its own.
